During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], at some point between [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] and [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]],<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] invaders '''subjugated''' [[Kintan/Legends|Kintan]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="GatORW" />

Though the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Kintan was not [[Terraforming/Legends|Vongformed]], nearly seventy-five percent of its population was either [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] or [[Death/Legends|slaughtered]]. Given the Nikto's combative nature, they were more often killed than captured by the Yuuzhan Vong.<ref name="GatORW" />

The Nikto who did survive the subjugation of Kintan went into hiding in the most remote portions of their homeworld.<ref name="GatORW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The subjugation of Kintan was first mentioned in ''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]'', a [[2004]] sourcebook for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]].<ref name="GatORW" />
